event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Berth 112, Belawan Port, Indonesia

sources.title: Piracy monthly report August 2023
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a berthed ship noticed three robbers armed with knives at the forecastle. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Upon hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s stores. Incident reported to the local authorities through the local agent.
